gate_findings.evidence: No project design basis is locked by this task. multiagent/tasks/BRD-043.json declares claim_ceiling=IDEA and required_gates=[]; multiagent/handoffs/BRD-043.codex.r001.json declares claim_level=IDEA and gates_completed=[]. There is no site, no code/version set, no geotech, hydraulic, wind or seismic exposure, no load combination and no design life. docs/design_basis/funicular_reference_basis.json is a module applicability basis (SI units, formulae, explicit assumptions, explicit limitations, order band) and not a project G0 design basis; the reviewer probe pinned it as a declaration only - PROV-07 reproduces basis.reference_source_sha256 = 529db0faa3c1d1e87b716cc54a962bae57150db91a0003e8152eacde27881a7c as an independently computed canonical digest of the two declared source files, and BASIS-01..BASIS-24 reject basis tamper and runtime source drift, including attempts to skew, widen or relabel the order band. One declaration gap is carried as a non-blocking residual limitation rather than as a gate item: the basis does not restate the inherited rise-to-span applicability domain [0.12, 0.35]. That floor is enforced upstream and re-verified live on every run - creative_shape.validate_candidate:918 calls validate_genome which checks rise_ratio against the live docs/design_basis/creative_shape_domain.json bounds, validate_candidate:925-928 recomputes expected_axis = generate_arch_axis(genome, domain) and rejects unless axis_points match exactly, validate_candidate:923 re-checks candidate.domain_sha256 against the live domain digest, and creative_domain_sha256 is pinned in BRD-043 upstream_basis_hashes - so H_ref = wL^2/(8f) is bounded by wL/0.96 and the near-flat blow-up is unreachable through the sanctioned chain; the bound is nevertheless silently dependent on an upstream file. No G0 item is claimed, assessed or discharged by this review and no G0 PASS is asserted.

No geometry-and-reality item is claimed or assessed. BRD-043 performs no clash detection and evaluates no fabrication, tolerance, transport, lift, erection or inspection-access requirement; the four artifacts contain no member sizing, connection or constructability content. The only geometry handled is the abstract single-span two-hinged arch axis, and the reviewer probe confirms its domain is fail-closed rather than validated against reality: GEOM-01..GEOM-08 reject a fully flat axis, fewer than three axis points, non-increasing rib abscissa, a non-finite ordinate, an endpoint lifted off the support line and a zero-length span before any division; GEOM-09 confirms datum handling at a common non-zero support elevation. Two declared geometry conventions are quantified and carried as non-blocking limitations. First, rise is taken as max(y) - support_y over the dense 101-point generator axis, so for an asymmetric axis the crown is not at midspan (largest measured crown offset |x/L-0.5| = 0.09 at DECK_ARCH/asym3, MOD-04) and H_ref is then the thrust of a symmetric parabola of that rise rather than the equilibrium thrust of the actual axis, a bias the order-band ratio inherits. Second, the reference rise is sampled on the generator axis while BRD-042 analyses the inscribed panel polygon whose crown sits lower (MOD-01: axis_rise 26.88 m versus polygon_rise 26.790591228844 m, gap 0.089408771156 m = 0.3326%; MOD-02 confirms deviation is sampled on 101 generator points, not on the ARCH_RIB elements actually analysed), so reference and measurement do not describe the same rise on skewed shapes. ASYM-<topology>-01/03 confirm asymmetric shapes are not laundered into canonical: within_tolerance=False with rms_ratio up to 0.047, maxdev_ratio up to 0.095 and mirror skew 1.945697067765 m, far above numerical noise. None of this constitutes G1 clearance and no G1 PASS is asserted.

No G2 item is claimed or discharged: there is no 3D model, no mesh or time-step convergence study, no element-suitability argument, no benchmark and no solver version/hash pinning, because the artifact is an F1-level closed-form static reference at claim IDEA. The reviewer verification below is recorded as evidence only, never as a gate PASS. Independent re-derivation: STAT-<topology>-01..08 on all three topologies reproduce w=W/L, H_ref=wL^2/(8f), y_ref=4f x(L-x)/L^2, V=w(L/2-x) and C=sqrt(H^2+V^2) from primitives through a code path independent of the module (math.sqrt where the module uses math.hypot), with 0 mismatches over 101 samples per topology: H=792.857142857143 kN at L=96.0 m and f=26.88 m, simple_beam_max=21312.0=H*f, V(0)=+888.0 kN, V(L)=-888.0 kN, C(mid)=H, W=1776.0 kN = q*L = the applied nodal sum, w=18.5 kN/m, deck=96.0 m; units close (kN/m * m -> kN, kN * m -> kNm) and V is correctly antisymmetric while C is a positive magnitude consistent with the schema exclusiveMinimum 0. STAT-*-07: the canonical zero-coefficient axis is funicular to rms_ratio=9.146e-17, maxdev_ratio=2.809e-16, bend_ratio=3.414e-16. One suspicion resolved as a confirmed invariant, not a defect: because H_ref*y_ref = M0 exactly, the module's own definitions force M_proxy = -H_ref*(y_actual - y_ref) at every sample, and since simple_beam_max = H_ref*f, bending_proxy_max_abs_ratio is identically equal to axis_max_abs_deviation_ratio for every shape (STAT-*-05 max residual 4e-12 kNm against a 2.1312e-04 kNm threshold on all three topologies; ASYM-*-02 residual ~6e-12 kNm with ratios_equal=True on six asymmetric runs). This is the genuine funicular closure identity and it confirms the sign, the 4f/L^2 coefficient and both normalisation denominators; the declared consequence is that canonical_funicular_within_tolerance = max(rms_ratio, maxdev_ratio, bend_ratio) <= tol has two independent terms and not three, and neither the basis formulae block nor the schema states the identity, so the artifact currently reads as if it reported two independent normalised measures. Traceability and closure: PAR-01..PAR-11 reject parent tamper, wrong status, wrong claim level, wrong verdict authority, wrong topology, incomplete mechanism detection and replaced upstream basis hashes, with PAR-11 confirming rejection occurs before any statics run (derive calls=0); OUT-01..OUT-31 reject output tamper including the layered attack that reseals the embedded parent, the manifest and then the outer hash; DET-01..DET-06 confirm determinism, manifest reproduction, that the input parent is not mutated and that the outer seal reproduces; SCH-20..SCH-23 confirm additionalProperties=false on the root, the nested reference object and every owned $def, the claim_level/design_verdict_authority/status/technical_scope constants, and the absence of any property named feasible, verified, design_pass, utilization, capacity_* or safe*. Three limitations are carried forward, none blocking. (a) Test coverage: the owner suite is narrower than the acceptance criteria it discharges - its order-band vocabulary assertion joins a dict and therefore inspects only the KEYS, so a verdict word planted in a VALUE slips past (CMP-12, slips=True, vacuous as written); no owner test builds a full outside-band artifact; the AST independence guard inspects only _derive_reference_result; and there is no owner test for a non-zero datum, axis degeneracy, zeroed or negative load fields, a tributary node-set mismatch, a zero deck length, a self-consistent non-uniform load or the layered reseal, while basis tampering covers roughly 4 of about 14 independently enforced invariants. Every listed gap is compensated by the reviewer probe (CMP-10 at the value level with offenders=[], CMP-07..CMP-09, IND-03, GEOM-05..GEOM-09, LOAD-07..LOAD-12, OUT-31, BASIS-01..BASIS-24), and no green owner test asserts anything false; follow-up hardening is recommended, not a REVISE trigger. (b) Defence in depth: funicular_reference.py:263-309 verifies each nodal load against its DECLARED tributary length and never re-derives tributary lengths from deck node spacing, so a redistribution that preserves sum(tributary)=L is accepted when the private _load_input is called directly (LOAD-11, W=1776.0); the identical redistribution applied to frame_model and study_model and resealed at both levels is still refused end-to-end because BRD-041 re-derives the conversion from the graph (LOAD-12), so the seam is not reachable through run_funicular_reference. LOAD-01..LOAD-10 additionally confirm fail-closed rejection of horizontal load, nodal moment, a second load case, a flipped direction, a stretched deck, skewed or zeroed nodal loads, a negative line load, a tributary node-set mismatch and a zero deck length. (c) Inherited vocabulary: the output embeds the whole parent study, which embeds the BRD-039 candidate whose checks[] carry a 'utilization' key from L0 screening (SCH-24 counts these inside parent_study while SCH-23 confirms none outside it), so the no-verdict property is per-owner and not per-file and a naive whole-file grep is not clean; this is not a BRD-043 defect. Probe trustworthiness was verified rather than assumed: record() derives status from a caller-computed boolean with no unguarded literal passed=True, expect_reject records only when a FunicularReferenceError was actually raised, expect_accept only after a clean return, and guard() converts any crash into PROBE_ERROR rather than silently skipping (0 produced). Honest reporting caveat: the summary counter observations=0 understates the review, because several substantive non-blocking observations are stored as PASS records that are unconditionally True (MOD-01, MOD-03, MOD-04) or where PASS means 'the weakness was demonstrated' (LOAD-11, CMP-12); their content was read directly from the result file rather than trusted from the counters. Owner test runs were 51/0/0/0 and 181/0/0/0; the probe ran 190 checks with 0 blocking findings, 0 probe errors and exit_code 0; PROV-00/PROV-08 report drifted=[] before and after the run. No G2 PASS is asserted.

No limit state is evaluated. BRD-043 computes no resistance and no load combination, and performs no strength, serviceability, stability, fatigue, robustness, dynamics, durability or construction-stage check; no margin against any design basis is demonstrated. contracts/funicular_reference_study.schema.json pins technical_scope = STATIC_FUNICULAR_REFERENCE_ONLY_NO_CAPACITY_OR_DESIGN_VERDICT, design_verdict_authority = NONE and claim_level = IDEA, and SCH-22/SCH-23 confirm no verdict-bearing property exists in the contract or in the live output outside parent_study. The bending proxy M_ref(x) = w x(L-x)/2 - H_ref y_actual(x) measures deviation from the ideal pressure line only; it is not a design internal force and does not substitute for frame, stability or nonlinear analysis. The H_ref-versus-F1 comparison is an order-of-magnitude alarm, not an acceptance limit: DECK_ARCH compares against the foundation thrust magnitude while THROUGH_ARCH and NETWORK_ARCH compare against the full signed deck axial envelope and require the whole envelope inside the band, which is the conservative reading; both sides are the horizontal force that closes the arch, so the ratio is physically meaningful and dimensionless (CMP-01..CMP-06 confirm the topology-to-action mapping, reproduction of the ratios from primitives, the reciprocal factor-five band (0.2, 5.0) and band membership), and load_funicular_basis enforces that the band is reciprocal-symmetric, brackets 1 and is labelled HEURISTIC_MODEL_ERROR_DETECTION_NOT_CODE_LIMIT. Two contract-surface limitations are carried, neither blocking. First, status is a schema const REFERENCE_COMPLETE, so an outside-band artifact still reports REFERENCE_COMPLETE and validates cleanly, unlike BRD-042 which demotes its own status to EXPECTED_ACTION_NOT_DETECTED: CMP-07 reaches the alarm end-to-end in production, not only through the private helper, reporting AGREEMENT_OUTSIDE_ORDER_BAND at ratio=0.786905115555 against a narrowed band (0.893452557777, 1.119253609266) with the source-digest guard intact; CMP-08 gives reason_codes exactly ['MEASURED_FORCE_OUTSIDE_HEURISTIC_ORDER_BAND'] with no added narrative; CMP-09 confirms the outside-band artifact still validates. This is a valid completion status meaning only 'the reference was computed' and is not a pass, and it is not a fail-closed defect because the band is by declaration not a gate; it IS a forward-compatibility hazard, since BRD-043 itself gates its parent on status == ACTION_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE and a future consumer copying that pattern would silently accept an outside-band reference, so any consumer must gate on reference_result.f1_comparison.agreement_status and reason_codes, never on status alone. Second, NOT_COMPARABLE is declared in the enum but unreachable at runtime, because _f1_comparison raises FunicularReferenceError on a non-positive measured force instead of emitting the label, and an accepted ACTION_DIAGNOSTIC_COMPLETE parent already guarantees a positive thrust or a tie in tension (CMP-11: emitted=['AGREEMENT_WITHIN_ORDER_BAND'] over all runs against three declared labels); raising is the safe direction and validate_funicular_reference fully re-derives reference_result so a hand-written NOT_COMPARABLE artifact cannot validate either. No G3 PASS is asserted.

Explicitly NOT discharged: there is no blind re-calculation by a different analyst using a different solver or method, and no tolerance reconciliation. The independence claim of BRD-043 applies to the reference EQUATIONS only and never to the process. Equations: funicular_reference.py neither imports nor names frame_f1 (IND-01 lists imports CONTRACTS_DIR, Path, REPO_ROOT, __future__, annotations, arch_action_f1, copy, deepcopy, hashlib, json, jsonschema, math, pathlib), _derive_reference_result and the input-derivation path contain no stiffness, displacement, reaction or element-end-force token (IND-02, IND-03, hits=[]), no such quantity enters H_ref, y_ref, V, C, M_proxy or any deviation metric, and the reference quantities are invariant when the measured force and the F1 result are perturbed (IND-04, IND-05); the only F1 quantity in the output is the measured side of the ratio in _f1_comparison, which is structurally separated from _derive_reference_result. Process: run_funicular_reference is NOT solver-free - _validated_parent calls arch_action_f1.validate_arch_action_study, which reaches frame_f1.analyze_frame_model and transitively the adapter's own re-solve, measured at 4 calls per run (IND-06, counted rather than assumed), so the same F1 stiffness kernel executes several times per run as lineage re-derivation. The closed form is also not an independently founded second model: MOD-03 shows the BRD-039 L0 screen CQD-L0-07 (creative_shape.py:823-828) evaluating H = q L^2/(8 rise) and C = hypot(H, qL/2) with demand 0.372015001086 MPa and the probe's independently recomputed closed form giving 0.372015001086 MPa, identical=True, so the overlap is exact and both inherit the same idealisation error if that closed form is inapplicable; BRD-043's contribution is the comparison against F1 plus the deviation and bending-proxy field, not a new closed form. The owner disclaims G4 correctly - basis explicit_limitations[0] states it is not a second frame solver and does not satisfy G4 by itself, handoff unresolved_risks[0] repeats it, and IND-08 reports disclaimed=True with overclaims=[] and no promotion token in any artifact (IND-07 confirms the reference identity depends only on lineage). Nothing in this artifact may be read as G4, as a second independent solver or as NUMERICALLY_VERIFIED. The exact overlap with CQD-L0-07 is stated in neither the basis nor the handoff and is carried as a non-blocking residual limitation. No G4 PASS is asserted.
